::: {.home-intro}
The Working Life and Social Policy Research Association (ÇAHSPAR) was established to improve the quality of working and social life through innovative, sustainable, not-for-profit research, training, projects and consultancy in working life and social policy. The association brings together scientific knowledge, vocational education and partnerships between public bodies, universities and civil society to contribute to a fairer and more sustainable world of work.
:::

## Our Activities

- Publishing research reports, policy briefs and bulletins
- Developing academic research and periodicals
- Organising training, seminars, conferences and workshops
- Delivering national and international projects
- Developing solutions for equality, inclusion and sustainability in working life
